svg.title: Freight operations assistant: proposed C4 Container diagram for a fifty-customer pilot
svg.desc: Proposed design, not implemented. Users submit questions through the Web Client and API Gateway. The Operations Assistant saves authorized jobs and returns a job ID. SQS sends jobs to workers. Workers compute complete SQL reports, use the model to explain facts, and share a carrier limiter backed by Postgres counters. Data and cache access use customer, team and user scope. Bulk ingestion keeps newer live data. A proposed document indexing job applies access metadata. CloudWatch tracks queue age, data age, errors and spend. Trackers and email are deferred.
svg.text: C4 Container diagram / Proposed architecture; not implemented
Return HTTP 202 or a valid cached answer.
Scope rules, jobs and versioned cache
Queue age, data age, errors, spend
Read scoped cache / save job + outbox / read result
SQL reports / save results / share cache and quota state
Use data versions and source time.
SQL checks the full shipment set.
Identity comes from Cognito. Data permissions come from trusted customer, team and user records.
Vector estimate: 9,000 / 300 × 175,750. Trackers and email are deferred. All application containers send logs.
